# dotenv

> Comment-preserving .env parser, editor & CLI for Go. Edit any entry — every other byte survives: comments, blank lines, ordering, quoting. dotenvctl: get/set/unset, env drift matrix, diff, run, GitHub Actions & Vercel secret sync. Docker Compose interpolation, zero dependencies, fuzz-tested.

dotenv is open source (ubgo/dotenv, Apache-2.0). The library is stdlib-only and never touches os.Environ; the dotenvctl CLI operates on local files and contacts a network service only when you explicitly push secrets via the gh or vercel CLIs.

- [README](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/README.md): the library — invariants, reading/writing, expansion, plugins, typed config
- [CLI overview](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/cli/README.md): dotenvctl — pitch, tour, comparison
- [Command reference](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/commands.md): every verb with real output
- [Multi-env tools](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/multi-env.md): envs, matrix, diff, HTML reports
- [Recipes](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/recipes.md): CI gates, env cloning, secret sync workflows
- [Go API](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/go-api.md): envkit operations, providerkit plugin kit, mounting the github/vercel plugins, embedding the CLI with dotenvcmd.Execute
- [Documentation home](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/README.md): 12-step learning path, start-from-your-goal table, index of every guide
- [Feature index](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/reference/features.md): all 122 features, each with its guide section and runnable Example functions
- [Reading a .env file](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/library/reading.md): load a .env and query it; what each accessor returns for duplicates and disabled lines
- [Entries and kinds](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/library/entries.md): Entry fields, the six Kind values and the exact line that produces each
- [.env syntax](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/library/syntax.md): quoting, comments, multi-line values, the : delimiter, key names, escapes, as input → Get → GetExpanded
- [Editing a .env file](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/library/editing.md): upsert vs literal edits, disable/restore, cloning between environments
- [Saving a .env file](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/library/saving.md): atomic writes, permission rules, line-ending preservation
- [Variable expansion](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/library/expansion.md): ${VAR}, every ${…} operator, $$, nesting and cycles, RequiredError, opt-in command substitution
- [Plugins](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/library/plugins.md): lookups, value transforms, save guards, command runners, observers, ordering, the firewall
- [Typed configuration](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/library/typed-config.md): binding values to typed structs with the standard library, go-envconfig, caarlos0/env or cfgkit
- [Choosing guides](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/choosing/README.md): decision tables: which entry point, edit method, expansion setup, plugin hook, CLI vs library vs embedding, sync backend, options per kind of app
- [Getting started](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): install dotenvctl, first commands, -f, --json, exit codes
- [Plugins overview](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/plugins.md): plugin namespaces, shared selection and safety flags, writing an exec plugin
- [GitHub plugin](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/plugins/github.md): push, list and prune GitHub Actions secrets via gh
- [Vercel plugin](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/docs/plugins/vercel.md): push, list and prune Vercel environment variables: targets, --sensitive, VERCEL_TOKEN
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/ubgo/dotenv/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute

## Install
- Library: `go get github.com/ubgo/dotenv@main`
- CLI: `go install github.com/ubgo/dotenv/cli/cmd/dotenvctl@main`
